text: Once you’re out, things you genuinely couldn’t see while you were bonded can start to show. Look at what you contributed, but also try to understand whatever was true in your ex’s perspective, including the conflicts they were carrying inside themselves, so they don’t turn into a cartoon villain in your head.
reader: Someone just out of a relationship, deciding what to tell people and how to see their ex.
